method.back_translator: roundtrip-back-translator: saw msgstr only; one Read, one Write
method.adjudicator: roundtrip-adjudicator: saw msgid, translator note and back-translation; never msgstr
method.supersedes_note: folio-assistant-lffo's 580/580 was self-checked by the translating agent; this run is independent
reruns: 2026-10-11: indexes 15 and 17 in all five locales, after the owner ruled that 'bean' is never translated as 'task' (a Task is its own term) and stays untranslated. Same two-agent protocol, on those 10 strings only (folio-core-2mb0).

2026-10-11, second ruling: 'bean' is translated after all, as each language's ordinary word for a bean or kernel (ar حبة, es grano, fr grain, ru зерно, zh 豆); DSpace 'Bundle' as 'File Set' (all five); ru 'item' as «единица хранения»; 'CDN edge' as the CDN's edge server (es, fr, ru); ru 12's catalogue made folio-assistant's own; zh 'size' as 大小, not 容量. 39 strings re-run; the adjudicator was given these rulings as a glossary.

roundtrip-fr.summary: fr: 115 pass, 5 warn, 0 fail of 120. Back-translator tools: Read,Write. Each entry awaits a reviewer's ruling; nothing was auto-corrected.

entries.msgid: Three routes to one item, which is the point. The catalogue knows this item once; the bytes are reachable upstream at WHO, here as a replica page, and from a CDN edge — jsDelivr serves any public repository, so the last one costs this project no hosting at all. The KG says what exists and where; the CDN says nothing and just serves it.
entries.msgstr: Trois accès à un même document, et c’est voulu. Le catalogue ne connaît ce document qu’une fois ; les octets sont accessibles en amont à l’OMS, ici sous forme de page de réplique et depuis un serveur de périphérie du CDN — jsDelivr sert tout dépôt public, si bien que le dernier ne coûte à ce projet aucun hébergement. Le graphe de connaissances dit ce qui existe et où ; le CDN ne dit rien et se contente de servir.
entries.back_translation: Three accesses to the same document, and that is intended. The catalogue knows this document only once; the bytes are accessible upstream at WHO, here as a replica page and from an edge server of the CDN — jsDelivr serves any public repository, so the last one costs this project no hosting. The knowledge graph says what exists and where; the CDN says nothing and merely serves.
findings: [term] DSpace 'item' is rendered as 'document' (three times), so the repository term is replaced by a generic word

entries.msgid: A cover is rendered and recorded for this item. It is not displayed: the publication's cover carries the WHO emblem, and this replica is not published under WHO.
entries.msgstr: Une couverture est générée et enregistrée pour ce document. Elle n’est pas affichée : la couverture de la publication porte l’emblème de l’OMS, et cette réplique n’est pas publiée sous l’égide de l’OMS.
entries.back_translation: A cover is generated and saved for this document. It is not displayed: the publication's cover bears the WHO emblem, and this replica is not published under the aegis of WHO.
findings: [sense] 'recorded for this item' (an entry in the catalogue) became 'saved for this document', which suggests a stored file rather than a catalogue record.

entries.msgid: Addressing follows the owner’s rule — <base-url>/<path-to-kind-or-node> — so an instance that instantiates a directory gets a visualiser mounted under that directory’s kind: /library/who-iris/, /docs/who-iris/, and so on.
entries.msgstr: L’adressage suit la règle du propriétaire — <base-url>/<path-to-kind-or-node> — de sorte qu’une instance qui instancie un répertoire obtient un visualiseur monté sous le type de ce répertoire : /library/who-iris/, /docs/who-iris/, etc.
entries.back_translation: Addressing follows the owner's rule — <base-url>/<path-to-kind-or-node> — so that an instance that instantiates a directory gets a viewer mounted under that directory's type: /library/who-iris/, /docs/who-iris/, etc.
findings: [term] 'kind' (a defined graph-typology term in the owner's addressing rule) became 'type', a near-synonym without that defined sense.

entries.msgid: Each row carries three routes to the same item: the IRIS source upstream at WHO, this repository's own local replica page, and the asset itself — downloadable from the repository and, separately, from a CDN edge.
entries.msgstr: Chaque ligne offre trois accès au même document : la source IRIS en amont à l’OMS, la page de réplique locale propre à ce dépôt, et la ressource elle-même — téléchargeable depuis le dépôt et, séparément, depuis un serveur de périphérie du CDN.
entries.back_translation: Each row offers three accesses to the same document: the IRIS source upstream at WHO, the local replica page belonging to this repository, and the resource itself — downloadable from the repository and, separately, from an edge server of the CDN.
findings: [term] DSpace 'item' is rendered as 'document' ('three accesses to the same document'), so the repository term is replaced by a generic word

entries.msgid: size upstream unknown — the storage report's second page was never read, and a number interpolated from the first would look measured
entries.msgstr: taille en amont inconnue — la deuxième page du rapport de stockage n’a jamais été lue, et un chiffre extrapolé à partir de la première aurait l’air mesuré
entries.back_translation: upstream size unknown — the second page of the storage report was never read, and a figure extrapolated from the first would look measured
findings: [sense] 'interpolated from the first' became 'extrapolated from the first', which is a different estimation method from the one the source names.

entries.msgid: Addressing follows the owner’s rule — <base-url>/<path-to-kind-or-node> — so an instance that instantiates a directory gets a visualiser mounted under that directory’s kind: /library/who-iris/, /docs/who-iris/, and so on.
